name: Average guesstimate: McDonald's India burgers via outlets, hand-waved basket assumption, no cross-check, generic range

messages.text: Estimate how many McDonald's burgers are sold per month in India.
Just to check, does burger include chicken and veg burgers and wraps, or only burgers? And a month is 30 days?
Burgers of any kind, veg or chicken. Wraps don't count. 30 days is fine.

I will go from the supply side, outlets times burgers per outlet. I think McDonald's has around 500 outlets in India, across the two franchise partners in the north-east and the west-south. For each outlet I will estimate orders per day and burgers per order, then multiply by 30.

A typical outlet in a mall or a high street is busy at lunch and dinner. I will say about 600 orders a day. On average an order has maybe one and a half burgers, since families order several and some people just get one. So 600 times 1.5 is 900 burgers per outlet per day.
Does every order include a burger?
Not every one, some people only get fries or a McFlurry or coffee. But the family orders have more burgers so I think 1.5 still roughly covers it. I will keep 900.
Are all 500 outlets as busy as a mall outlet?

Probably the highway and smaller city ones are slower, and the delivery orders in the metros add some, so I think it evens out. 500 outlets times 900 is 450,000 burgers a day, and times 30 is 13.5 million burgers a month.
About 13.5 million burgers a month, could be anywhere from 10 to 15 million depending on the assumptions. The orders per day number is the biggest one.
